description: Individual menu item for TmDropdown. Supports an optional icon, disabled state, and passes its Value to the parent dropdown on click.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: Value passed to TmDropdown.OnSelect when clicked.

parameters.name: Class
parameters.description: Additional CSS class for the item.

parameters.name: AriaDisabled
parameters.description: Marks the item aria-disabled="true" and paints the disabled style while leaving it focusable, so a keyboard or screen-reader user can land on it and hear its explanation. A click does nothing. Unlike Disabled, the native disabled attribute is not set.

parameters.name: Checked
parameters.description: When set, the item is a radio choice (role=menuitemradio) and this is its checked state. Null keeps the plain menuitem. A non-null value also renders a leading check indicator, so the choice is not announced by colour alone.

parameters.name: KeepOpen
parameters.description: When true, choosing this item does not close the menu and focus stays on the item. Use it for a choice the user makes before picking another item, such as a radio scope.
